name: browser-extension
description: Chrome extension that fills logins from the password vault on your Quark

scripts.build: wxt build -b chrome && wxt build -b firefox
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:scripts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:chrome && playwright test -c e2e
scripts.package: wxt zip -b chrome && wxt zip -b firefox
scripts.test:e2e:mock: npm run build:chrome && E2E_TARGET=mock playwright test -c e2e
scripts.test:e2e:firefox: npm run build:firefox && playwright test -c e2e/firefox
scripts.test:e2e:firefox:mock: npm run build:firefox && E2E_TARGET=mock playwright test -c e2e/firefox
